# Local experiment

Fix this single-record CSV parser to handle quoted commas and doubled quotes. Add `stringifyRecord(fields)` with parse/stringify roundtrip for string arrays (at least one field), escaping quotes and commas. Preserve spaces exactly. Reject unterminated/misplaced quotes, text after a closing quote, nonstring fields, and any CR/LF (single-record format) with an Error. Add useful tests, update README, run the registered Node test profile, and finish with a local Git commit. No packages or network are needed.

item.text: The parser currently splits on every comma. I’ve replaced it with a state-based parser that handles quoted fields and rejects malformed quotes. The tests will cover spacing, invalid input, and roundtrips for combinations of empty fields, commas, and quotes.
